turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, I'm Dr. Liew from the anesthesia team. May I ask you a few questions to prepare for your knee surgery tomorrow?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, doctor. Sure thing. I'm having this arthroscopy because my left knee's been giving me trouble for months, right? The doctor said it's a torn meniscus.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. Can you tell me about any medications you're currently taking?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I use fluticasone nasal spray every day, one spray each nostril. And I was on doxycycline 100mg daily for a skin infection, but I stopped that two weeks ago, lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Do you have any allergies to medications or other substances?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, yes! I'm allergic to penicillin. Had a bad rash when I took it as a teenager. The doctor stopped it immediately. But funny thing, my records say no allergies, but I remember telling them before...

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for clarifying that. We'll make sure to note the penicillin allergy in your chart. When did you last have something to eat or drink?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Had dinner at 8 PM last night, and I sipped water until 6 AM this morning. Followed the fasting instructions, doctor.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Have you had any previous surgeries or anesthesia?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, I had a spinal block for a hernia surgery five years ago. Woke up fine, no issues at all.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to know. How's your overall mobility? Any difficulty walking or climbing stairs?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: My knee's been painful, so I walk slower now. Stairs are a bit of a struggle, but I manage with the handrail, lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Any other medical conditions we should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I've got allergic rhinitis, that's why I use the nasal spray. Gets worse during the rainy season, but it's controlled now.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for sharing all that. We'll proceed with general anesthesia combined with spinal for your surgery. You'll be asleep but with the spinal to keep your leg numb during the procedure.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Sounds good, doctor. I'm ready to get this sorted out.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Wonderful. We'll see you in the holding area tomorrow. Any questions before we finish?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No questions, thank you. I appreciate the explanation.
